# glinet_dns (Resource)

Manage the singleton GL.iNet stock DNS provider (`gl-dns-v2`). The encrypted-DNS provider metadata and endpoint are validated before apply. Destroy releases ownership and preserves the firmware section.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `servers` (Set of String) Provider server names from `/etc/dnsproxy/provider/<provider>`.

### Optional

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dns_provider` (String) Stock DNS provider name.
- `force_dns` (Boolean) Force all clients through this DNS.
- `manual_enable` (Boolean) Enable manual DNS selection.
- `manual_local_dns` (Boolean) Use the local encrypted DNS proxy.
- `manual_type` (String) Manual DNS type.
- `mode` (String) GL.iNet DNS mode.
- `override_vpn` (Boolean) Override VPN DNS.
- `protocol` (String) Encrypted DNS protocol: `doh`, `dot`, or `udp`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
